task_title: Board shrink check on the commit path (tasks.jsonl row-loss guard)
task_criteria: AC1: commit refuses a board shrink (exit 1, both counts + lost ids, commit not landed). AC2: legitimate append/in-place edit passes. AC3: BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override passes and still names counts+lost ids. AC4: the truncating lane close writer is fixed or quarantined so it never reduces rows. AC5: boardctl validate RESULT OK on repaired board and scratch copy.

items.detail: AC1: scripts/board_shrink_check.py:170-186 exits 1 with 'REFUSED baseline=<old> candidate=<new> lost ids=...' on stderr; tests/test_board_shrink_check.py:127-141 asserts rc==1, 'baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C', and HEAD unchanged (also board deletion, candidate=0). AC2: test_append_and_same_count_edit_pass and test_adding_the_board_for_the_first_time_passes (lines 143-160); live run on this repo: `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py` -> 'board-shrink: OK baseline=298 candidate=298' rc=0. AC3: checker lines 171-176 print 'NOTICE BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK override: baseline=.. candidate=.. lost ids=..' and exit 0; test_override_lands_and_still_names_counts_and_ids (line 200) asserts NOTICE + both counts + lost ids and that the prune landed. AC4: the truncating writer was an ad-hoc lane-session snippet outside this repo (checker header lines 43-52), so the fix is quarantine: the managed pre-commit block (.git/hooks/pre-commit:2-10, installed and verified) refuses any row-loss rewrite from any source; grep for tasks.jsonl writers in-repo finds only readers (auger.py:12258, scripts/audit_board_evidence.py, scripts/gen_trace_artifact.py) and the foreman close writer board_row_closeout.py:104-132 rewrites line-wise byte-preserving every non-target row, so no tracked writer reduces rows; test_the_real_297_row_board_rewrite_is_quarantined replays the 45a29b9 incident (298->2 refused, commit not landed). AC5: `boardctl -C /home/kara/auger validate` -> 'RESULT: OK (439 warning(s))' rc=0; scratch copy (mktemp dir with tasks.jsonl+events.jsonl) -> 'RESULT: OK (440 warning(s))' rc=0; all 298 board rows parse as JSON objects with string ids. Fresh focused run: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_board_shrink_check.py -q` -> '19 passed in 6.01s' exit 0; Tier-1 full gate also green (828 passed, GATE PASS, exit 0) with this file in the gate pytest arm (tests/gate.sh:244).

items.criterion: Reachability: the shrink check is actually on the commit path (installed pre-commit hook), on the CI path, and in the gate's pytest arm
items.detail: Hook: .git/hooks/pre-commit lines 2-10 contain the managed block running `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py` whenever the staged diff touches .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl (fail-closed on unreadable diff); installer re-run on this repo printed 'board-shrink: installed /home/kara/auger/.git/hooks/pre-commit' rc=0 with exactly one BEGIN and one END marker (idempotent). CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml:71 runs `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py --recent` before the gate step with fetch-depth: 0; ci.yml:149 runs the focused pytest file. Gate: tests/gate.sh:244 names tests/test_board_shrink_check.py in the pytest arm.

items.criterion: Failure path: the check fails closed (exit 1) on unresolvable baseline, torn rows, and board deletion — never passes blind
items.detail: Fresh test run (19 passed, exit 0) includes test_missing_parent_fails_closed_naming_the_deepen_hint (shallow clone --recent -> rc 1 naming 'git fetch --deepen=1'), test_override_does_not_excuse_a_parse_failure (torn row + BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 -> rc 1, commit not landed), and test_deleting_the_board_is_refused (candidate=0 -> rc 1). Code: scripts/board_shrink_check.py:152-158 returns 1 on any parse failure; read_blob (lines 88-109) raises ValueError on an unresolvable baseline and main returns 1.

python3 -c "import json,sys
ok=True
for i,l in enumerate(open('.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl'),1):
    l=l.strip()
    if not l: continue
    try:
        r=json.loads(l)
        assert isinstance(r.get('id'),str) and r['id']
